messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: Elevated quality-regression-rate detected on text generation endpoints (global) at 2025-02-14T03:22:01Z. Signal: 'structured-output-failures' breached threshold. Preliminary suspect: frugal-orchestrator increased weight to cheap-quant-3 which has known degradation on long-structured prompts. Dashboard: <https://console.redwood.example/alerts/2005554321|view alert>

lee-sre: Acked. I'm taking oncall. Pulling routing history and operator run logs.

maya: Seeing sharp jump in cheap-quant-3 weight at 03:21:45Z from ~12% -> ~68% for latency-sensitive buckets in EU and APAC. Error rate for JSON/CSV outputs +30% within that window.

arun: Which operator run did that? frugal-orchestrator was scheduled for low-latency optimization this morning.

ml-ops-bot: Operator execution: frugal-orchestrator v2.7 ran at 2025-02-14T03:21:40Z. Canary mode: auto with sample_set=short-prompts-v2 (does NOT include enterprise-structured-prompts). Reported confidence: high.

eng-runtime: Looks like the optimizer's eval set omitted the enterprise corpus due to a stale manifest in the ops bucket. That inflated quality score for cheap-quant-3. Also seeing capacity throttles in eu-west at 03:21:50Z triggering cross-zone fallback for a short period.

sofia-cs: CS reports multiple enterprise customers with broken webhook parsing; some integrations rejected payloads. Initial impacted customers ~41, 9 high-priority. Drafting notification.

lee-sre: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) emergency pin latency-sensitive routes to stable-xl-1, 2) pause frugal-orchestrator, 3) apply soft rate-limits to cheap-quant-3, 4) notify finance. Implementing patch now.

console-bot: PATCH /api/v1/policies/cost-routing/global applied by lee-sre at 2025-02-14T03:25:12Z

```
{ "pin_variant": "stable-xl-1", "override_ttl": 3600 }
```

console-bot: Routing weights updated: stable-xl-1 -> 90%, cheap-quant-3 -> 3%.

maya: Metrics: within ~80s we see structured-output failure rate drop back near baseline in EU. APAC shows similar improvement after spillback.

arun: Pausing frugal-orchestrator now. POST /api/v1/operators/frugal-orchestrator/pause -> success. Operator will not run until manual resume.

eng-runtime: Adding soft token-rate-limit on cheap-quant-3 across regions while we monitor: token-rate-limit = 0.07 RPS, ttl 45m.

console-bot: Rate-limit applied by lee-sre at 2025-02-14T03:27:40Z.

billing-bot: Finance alert: emergency pin increases estimated cost for next hour by ~19%. Billing team notified.

sofia-cs: Draft outbound: "We detected an automated routing change that temporarily routed some traffic to a lower-cost model variant, which may have resulted in lower-quality outputs for a subset of requests. We reverted routing and are investigating. If you saw issues please reply with request IDs and timestamps. We can replay requests on a stable model on request." Posting to #cs-outbound after review.

maya: Forensics: sample req r-7d4e: stable-xl-1 -> valid JSON with required fields. cheap-quant-3 -> truncated JSON, missing 'items' array and added spurious 'promo' field. Attaching samples to ticket INC-2025-02-frugal-fallback.

eng-runtime: Region fallback trace: short-lived eu-west soft throttle at 03:21:50Z caused routing to attempt eu->eu-alt then briefly eu->us-east for some requests (03:21:52Z-03:22:05Z). That increased the blast radius for customers pinned to EU. No global loop observed.

lee-sre: Handoff: I'll monitor until 04:00Z then @arun will take over. Current status: mitigated and monitoring. Action items for next shift: 1) ML to audit operator eval manifests, 2) enforce single-run delta cap, 3) add enterprise smoke checks before applying >10% weight changes.

arun: On it. I'll validate the operator manifests and check whether the canary harness masked long-form prompts. Also will ensure manual gate for >20% and require a preflight sample against enterprise suite.

ml-ops-bot: Planned fixes: 1) validate and freeze eval manifests in CI, 2) add a preflight enterprise-sanity test that must pass for canary to be considered green, 3) reduce max single-run weight delta to 15%. ETA: patch release tomorrow morning.

sofia-cs: CS will send targeted notices to the 9 high-priority customers within 30 minutes and offer technical replay/support.

billing-bot: Finance will reconcile the temporary cost delta; note for billing: do not auto-credit until manual review with CS.

maya: Adding timeline notes for postmortem: optimizer run 03:21:40Z -> alert 03:22:01Z -> patch 03:25:12Z -> improvements 03:26:40Z -> operator paused 03:27:10Z.

eng-runtime: Root cause (prelim): frugal-orchestrator used an eval sample set missing enterprise structured prompts due to a stale manifest; that produced an overconfident score for cheap-quant-3 and led to a large weight bump. Throttle-induced fallback briefly expanded exposure.

lee-sre: Creating postmortem doc and scheduling a blameless review at 2025-02-15T10:00PT. Tagging eng-runtime, ml-ops, and CS.

sofia-cs: Outbound posted. Customers responded with ~12 request IDs; CS collecting and offering replays and fixes.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated; root-cause under investigation; postmortem in progress.

lee-sre: Closing thread for now; will re-open if we see reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:
